ConnectionStrings._comment: Used ONLY when Persistence:Mode is Postgres. The default mode is Sqlite, which ignores this.

Persistence._comment: Identity is the only persisted store in the application. Mode: Sqlite (a local file, the default — no database server, no bill), InMemory (SQLite in process; wiped on restart), or Postgres (enterprise; applies the EF migrations in Akshaya.Api on startup).

SeedUser._comment: Created ONLY when the users table is empty. Enabled null means on for Sqlite/InMemory and off for Postgres. Leave Password empty and a random one is generated and logged once at startup.

CredentialProtection._comment: Master keys for the saved-broker-credential vault. NEVER commit a real key here. Supply via environment (CredentialProtection__Keys__<id>) or a secret store; appsettings.Development.json holds a throwaway dev key.

InstrumentMaster._comment: One shared, searchable copy of each connector's instrument list. RefreshInterval trades staleness against re-downloading a master that can run to hundreds of thousands of rows; masters change once a day.
